claim: Full-time employees get 27 days of paid annual leave per year.

context.text: Every full-time employee at Thimblewood Instruments receives 27 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. On top of this, the Pellmoor workshop closes for three 'Quiet Days' between Christmas and New Year, which are paid and do not count against annual leave. Part-time staff receive annual leave pro rata to their contracted hours.

claim: Hotel rooms in capital cities are capped at EUR 230 per night.

context.text: Hotel rooms are capped at EUR 160 per night in most cities and EUR 230 per night in capital cities. Employees who stay with friends or family instead may claim a flat EUR 40 hospitality allowance per night.

claim: Hotel bookings must be approved by a director.

claim: The company matches employee pension contributions up to 7%.

context.text: Thimblewood pays a pension contribution equal to 7% of salary for every employee who contributes at least 4% of their own salary. Employees are enrolled automatically when their 3-month probation period ends and may opt out at any time.

claim: Laptops are replaced every four years.

context.text: On their first day, new employees choose either a 14-inch Linux laptop or a 14-inch macOS laptop. Laptops are refreshed every 4 years, or sooner if the IT desk certifies a fault that cannot be repaired.

claim: Flights longer than 7 hours may be booked in premium economy.

context.text: Rail is required for any journey that takes under 5 hours door to door. Flights are booked in economy class, except flights longer than 7 hours, which may be booked in premium economy. Business class is never reimbursed.

Hotel rooms are capped at EUR 160 per night in most cities and EUR 230 per night in capital cities. Employees who stay with friends or family instead may claim a flat EUR 40 hospitality allowance per night.

claim: A lost hardware key must be reported to the security team within 1 hour.

context.text: Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to the IT desk within 24 hours through the #it-desk channel. The company covers the first accidental-damage claim per device; a second claim on the same device within 12 months costs the employee a EUR 75 excess.

Suspicious emails are reported with the 'Report phish' button in the mail app. Any suspected security incident, including a compromised account or a lost hardware key, must be reported to the security team within 1 hour by calling the security hotline.

claim: Leave days carried over expire if not taken by 30 April.

context.text: Up to 6 unused annual-leave days may be carried into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be taken by 30 April or they are lost. Unused leave is never exchanged for pay, except in an employee's final salary when they leave the company.

claim: Employees who cycle to work at least three days a week get EUR 30 a month.

context.text: Through the cycle-to-work scheme, employees can lease a bicycle worth up to EUR 2,500 by salary sacrifice over 24 months. Anyone who commutes by bike or on foot at least 3 days a week receives a EUR 30 'active commute' bonus every month.
